observation: Spec AC#2 named both 'prompt' and 'attachments' as editable fields, but the routines table has no attachments column — track boundary forbids inventing a routine model. Planner caught this before build and flagged it as deferred, delivering prompt-only. Resolved without rework, but late discovery (at spec time) of schema mismatch would have been caught earlier with a schema audit.
suggestion: Refine gate should verify that every AC field has backing schema/API contract; flag schema-required ACs that lack a column/route before architecture lock-in.

observation: Track AV registration was on origin/main but not in the local worktree at start — required a fetch and manual consultation of origin/main TRACK-AV.md. Minor friction in pipeline initialization.
suggestion: Pipeline startup should auto-fetch and verify work-package TRACK files are in sync with origin/main before building.

observation: Prompt-as-description mapping and `useRoutine` refetch addition were straightforward refactors of existing patterns — no novel logic. Design extraction (Row/KeyValue/ItemList) from review/conversations precedent meant zero invented primitives.
suggestion: EXTRACT-class WPs consistently ship faster and with fewer surprises than novel designs — validates the standing rule to search before inventing.

observation: Spec explicitly called out potential hook-placement pitfall (conditional-hook violation risk in WorkTeamLoaded). Builder placed hooks correctly at the top of the function after roster setup, avoiding the named risk entirely.
suggestion: Detailed architecture risk flags with specific code landmarks (function names, line regions) prevent silent assumption drift during build.

observation: AgentDetailPane was created as a new shared pane (lifted from AgentEditDialog body), but the old AgentEditDialog.tsx was deleted. Review flagged a dead parallel copy (AgentEditDialog.stories.tsx) that had survived the main body deletion — the story file's import kept it alive and knip didn't catch it.
suggestion: When lifting/moving component bodies, grep for all `.stories.ts`, `.test.ts`, and `.tsx` companions and delete/relocate them together. A surviving story file is a code-smell for incomplete migration.

observation: De-greying of WorkRoutine sections via Row/KeyValue/ItemList primitives and budget-stop amber color mapping (RowDot tone=warning → #d97706) were proven both via DOM tests (no surface-container bg class) and paint verification against tokens.
suggestion: Visual-property ACs (de-grey, color fidelity) are unprovable via lint alone — test DOM assertions + screenshot read are the only backstops. The plan's explicit token traceability (--status-warning === --accent-secondary) prevented color-mapping errors.

observation: Split-pane wiring (useUiPreference surfaceKey, mode='split', onModeChange fold-back behavior) matched ReviewComposition and Conversations patterns exactly — no deviations from precedent. Existing tests on WorkTeam (no-selection path) were untouched, lowering regression risk.
suggestion: Following established design patterns verbatim (not variant-izing) reduces hidden integration bugs and keeps test update scope minimal.

observation: Three AV4-specific test files (RoutineDetailPane.AV4.test.tsx, AgentDetailPane.AV4.test.tsx, WorkTeam.AV4.test.tsx) delivered full AC coverage including split-render, editable-save PATCH, de-grey DOM assertions, and agent-pane-no-dialog checks. Builder proved all ACs before ship.
suggestion: Test naming convention (FileName.WPID.test.tsx) makes AC-to-test traceability explicit and aids retro review — consider standardizing workpackage-specific tests with this suffix.
